description: Parallel-no-cross scenario: fastLine always strictly above slowLine throughout all 5 bars. Both lines trend upward in parallel with no sign change in (fast-slow). The diff series is always positive (2.0 throughout), so no bullish or bearish cross event fires. Verifies DetectCross returns an empty event slice (not nil — nil vs empty is a valid implementation detail, but eventCount must be 0) without error when given valid input with no crossovers.

expectedOutput.note: diff[i]=(fast-slow)=[2.0,2.5,3.0,3.0,2.5] — always positive. No sign change → no cross events. Empty slice returned (not nil error). eventCount MUST be 0.
